Free AI course 3 of 5: Microsoft Learn 🎯

“Plan something fun” gets you one kind of answer. Add who it is for, your limits and the format you want—and you give AI a much clearer job.

Microsoft’s free learning module, Introduction to generative AI and agents, covers language models, prompts and the building blocks of AI agents. It has 7 units, including an exercise and an assessment. Basic familiarity with AI and machine learning is recommended.

My learning plan: explain each idea in your own words, do the chat-playground exercise, then compare a vague prompt with a specific one. Check whether the second answer actually follows your constraints.

Try our game-night example: “Plan a 2-hour indoor game night for 4 friends. Use things we already own. Give a timeline and 3 games.” This is our practice suggestion, not a Microsoft assignment.

Course link:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/fundamentals-generative-ai/

Save this for your next learning session. What would you ask an AI agent to help you do?

#LearnAI #MicrosoftLearn #PromptEngineering #AIAgents #BuildWithAI
